Hi everyone,
I currently have a single-model pipeline scoring 0.940 on the public leaderboard. I am actively working on improving my local CV and exploring new architectures, but I believe the fastest way to climb to the top of the leaderboard right now is strategic ensembling.
I am looking to merge with a team or solo competitor who fulfills the following:

Score: Holds a stable public LB score of 0.935+ (or a very strong local CV).

Diversity: Uses a different model backbone, unique data augmentations, or a distinct post-processing approach compared to standard baselines.

Goal: Highly motivated to actively experiment, share insights, and secure a top spot.

By cross-multiplying/ensembling our diverse out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, we can significantly boost our robust generalization and minimize public LB overfitting.If you have a complementary pipeline and want to join forces to secure a gold medal, please drop a comment below or send me a direct message with:Your current CV/LB score.A brief overview of your model architecture (to ensure diversity).

Let's team up and push the boundaries!
